sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and router setup
sections.what: Loads the web tools, the database connection, the table definitions and the request shapes, then creates the router.
sections.why: Likely reason: the same pattern as the other route files.
sections.watch_out: These routes only work once this router is attached to the main app elsewhere.

sections.name: create_model
sections.title: Creating a model
sections.what: Saves a new model from the given fields and returns the saved record with its new id and timestamps.
sections.why: Likely reason: the standard way to add a record and show what was stored.
sections.watch_out: There is no check for duplicate names, so two models can share a name.

sections.name: list_models
sections.title: Listing all models
sections.what: Returns every model in the database.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: All records are returned at once, so many models will slow this route.

sections.name: get_model
sections.title: Reading one model
sections.what: Returns one model by id, or a not-found error if it does not exist.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The id must match exactly as stored.

sections.name: delete_model
sections.title: Deleting a model
sections.what: Deletes one model and returns a success message, or a not-found error.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Whether linked scenarios and results are also deleted depends on database rules that are not in this file.

summary: Routes that create, list, read and delete financial models stored in the database.
purpose: Manage the list of models the user works on. A model is the top-level item that scenarios belong to.
why: Likely reason: everything else, such as scenarios and results, is attached to a model.
how: Create saves a new model from the given fields and returns it. List returns all models. Get returns one model by id or a not-found error. Delete removes one model by id and saves the change.
inputs: On create: name, currency, unit divisor, start year, horizon years and granularity. On read or delete: the model id in the web address.
outputs: Saved model records, a list of models, or a success message after deletion.
risks: Deleting a model may also delete its linked scenarios and results, depending on rules in the database models file, which is not shown here. The list route has no paging.
debug: If a model is not found, confirm the id. If delete removes more than expected, check the cascade setting in the database models. If create fails, check the database connection.
